sentences.quote: People often wonder why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others.

analysis.translationLiteral: 人们常常想知道为什么有些企业家比另一些人更成功。
analysis.translationNatural: 大家总好奇：同样做企业，为什么有人更成功？
analysis.structMarkup: 【People】 often _wonder_ {why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（why 引导）

components.note: 复数泛指「人们」，谓语用原形 wonder
后接 why 从句说明好奇的内容

components.part: why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others
components.note: why 引导，用陈述语序

clauses: why 引导宾语从句，作 wonder 的宾语，从句用陈述语序。
analysis.paragraphRole: 以设问开篇，引出全文主题：成功差异从何而来。

sentences.quote: Is it habits, connections, luck, work ethic or any other behavior?

analysis.translationLiteral: 它是习惯、人脉、运气、职业精神，还是任何别的行为吗？
analysis.translationNatural: 到底靠习惯、关系、运气、拼劲，还是别的什么？
analysis.structMarkup: _Is_ 【it】 ~habits, connections, luck, work ethic or any other behavior~?
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表（一般疑问句，表语为并列名词短语）

components.note: 一般疑问句中系动词提到主语之前
指代上句所说的成功差异

components.part: habits, connections, luck, work ethic or any other behavior
components.note: 并列名词短语作表语，最后一项用 or 连接

pitfalls: 一般疑问句把系动词提前，主语 it 落在后面。
analysis.paragraphRole: 罗列几种常见归因，为下一句作者给出自己的答案蓄势。

sentences.quote: I believe the key to success is willpower.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我相信成功的关键是意志力。
analysis.translationNatural: 而我的看法是：成功的关键，在于意志力。
analysis.structMarkup: 【I】 _believe_ {the key to success is willpower}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（省略连词 that）

components.note: 第一人称，表明这是作者观点
后接宾语从句，连词 that 被省略

components.part: the key to success is willpower
components.note: 从句自身是主系表结构

clauses: 省略连词 that 的宾语从句，作 believe 的宾语。

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不能接动词原形。
phrases.example: Practice is the key to improvement. 练习是进步的关键。

pitfalls: the key to 中的 to 是介词，后面接名词，不能写成 the key to do。
analysis.paragraphRole: 亮出全文中心论点：意志力才是成功的关键。

sentences.quote: Willpower is the ability to control yourself.

analysis.translationLiteral: 意志力是控制你自己的能力。
analysis.translationNatural: 所谓意志力，就是能管住自己。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Willpower】 _is_ ~the ability to control yourself~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 不定式作后置定语

components.note: 抽象不可数名词，系动词用 is
连接主语与表语
核心词 ability，不定式作后置定语

phrases.usage: ability 后接不定式作定语，不说 ability of doing。
phrases.example: She has the ability to lead a team. 她有带团队的能力。

analysis.paragraphRole: 给意志力下第一个定义：自我控制的能力。

sentences.quote: It is a strong determination that allows you to do something difficult.

analysis.translationLiteral: 它是一种强大的决心，这种决心让你能够做困难的事。
analysis.translationNatural: 它也是一股狠劲，能推着你去啃难啃的骨头。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】 _is_ ~a strong determination~ {that allows you to do something difficult}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 定语从句（that 引导）

components.note: 承接上句，指代 willpower
主系表结构
名词短语作表语，后接定语从句

components.part: that allows you to do something difficult
components.note: that 在从句中作主语，allow sb to do 为固定搭配

clauses: that 引导定语从句修饰 determination，that 在从句中作主语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 补充定义：意志力是让人能做难事的坚定决心。

sentences.quote: It is a behavior we are born with more than one we learn; however, it is possible to not only learn it, but also strengthen it with constant exercise.

analysis.translationLiteral: 它是一种我们与生俱来胜过学得的行为；然而，不仅学会它是可能的，而且用不断练习强化它也是可能的。
analysis.translationNatural: 它更像是天生带来的，而不是后天学来的；不过你既能把它练出来，也能靠持续锻炼把它变强。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】 _is_ ~a behavior we are born with more than one we learn~; (however), it is possible to not only learn it, but also strengthen it with constant exercise.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表（含省略关系代词的定语从句）；分号后为 it 形式主语 + not only...but also... 并列不定式

components.note: 指代 willpower
连接表语

components.part: a behavior we are born with more than one we learn
components.note: we are born with 是省略关系代词的定语从句
转折连接副词，前后用分号与逗号

clauses: we are born with 是省略 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 a behavior。

phrases.usage: 连接并列成分，前后结构必须一致；置于句首时主句要部分倒装。
phrases.example: He not only reads but also writes every day. 他每天不仅阅读还写作。

pitfalls: more than 在此表示「与其说是……不如说是」，不是数量上的比较。
分号后的 it 是形式主语，真正主语是不定式 to not only learn... but also strengthen...。
analysis.paragraphRole: 先让步再转折，落到全文最关键的判断：意志力可以靠持续练习增强，对应第 46 题。

sentences.quote: Willpower is just like a muscle; to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it.

analysis.translationLiteral: 意志力就像一块肌肉；为了让它保持强壮，你需要不断地锻炼它。
analysis.translationNatural: 意志力跟肌肉一个道理：想让它有力气，就得天天练。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Willpower】 _is_ ~just like a muscle~; (to keep it strong) 【you】 need to constantly exercise it.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表；分号后为不定式目的状语 + 主谓宾

components.note: 抽象名词作主语
主系表结构
介词短语作表语，构成类比
不定式作目的状语，keep + 宾语 + 形容词
分号后分句的主语，泛指读者

phrases.usage: like 作介词，后接名词或动名词；just 用来加强语气。
phrases.example: It works just like a charm. 它就像魔法一样管用。

analysis.paragraphRole: 用肌肉类比，把「持续锻炼」这个可操作结论立起来。

sentences.quote: People with a great amount of willpower have the discipline to develop positive, successful habits.

analysis.translationLiteral: 拥有大量意志力的人，具备养成积极且成功习惯的自律。
analysis.translationNatural: 意志力足的人，往往自律到能养出一套好习惯。
analysis.structMarkup: 【People with a great amount of willpower】 _have_ ~the discipline to develop positive, successful habits~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 介词短语作后置定语 + 不定式作后置定语

components.part: People with a great amount of willpower
components.note: 核心词是 People，with... 只是后置定语，谓语用复数
及物动词，后接名词宾语

components.part: the discipline to develop positive, successful habits
components.note: 核心词 discipline，不定式说明是哪方面的自律

pitfalls: 主语核心词是复数 People，不能被 with 短语里的单数名词带偏，谓语用 have。
analysis.paragraphRole: 正面说明意志力强的人拥有养成好习惯的自律。

sentences.quote: Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.

analysis.translationLiteral: 即使拥有惊人的天赋，若没有养成积极习惯的自律与动力，要取得成功也可能是困难的。
analysis.translationNatural: 天赋再高，缺了那份自律和劲头，成功照样很难。
analysis.structMarkup: (Even with an incredible amount of talent), (without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits), 【it】 _can be_ ~difficult~ (to achieve success).
analysis.structureSummary: it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 两个介词短语作让步/条件状语

components.part: Even with an incredible amount of talent
components.note: with 短语表让步，Even 加强语气

components.part: without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits
components.note: without 短语表条件，与前一个 with 形成对照
形式主语，真正主语是句末不定式
情态动词 + be，表示可能性
形容词作表语
不定式是真正的主语内容

pitfalls: it 是形式主语，真正主语是 to achieve success；句首两个介词短语都不是主句成分。
analysis.paragraphRole: 反面论证：光有天赋、缺自律也难成功，回扣首段的归因设问。

sentences.quote: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.

analysis.translationLiteral: 意志力与习惯手拉手地同行。
analysis.translationNatural: 意志力和习惯，是绑在一起的。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Willpower and habits】 _go_ (hand in hand).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 固定短语作状语

components.note: 并列名词作主语，谓语用复数 go
此处意为「（两者）相伴而行」
固定短语，修饰 go

phrases.usage: 主语通常是两个并列事物或复数名词。
phrases.example: Health and sleep go hand in hand. 健康与睡眠密不可分。

analysis.paragraphRole: 点明意志力与习惯相辅相成，开启第三段的习惯论述。

sentences.quote: It is critical to create good habits and take the actions necessary to stick to those habits day in and day out for greater success.

analysis.translationLiteral: 养成好习惯、并采取必要的行动日复一日地坚持这些习惯，是至关重要的。
analysis.translationNatural: 想更成功，关键是养成好习惯，并且天天照着做。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】 _is_ ~critical~ (to create good habits and take the actions necessary to stick to those habits day in and day out for greater success).
analysis.structureSummary: it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 并列不定式作真正主语

components.note: 形式主语
连接表语
意为「至关重要的」

components.part: to create good habits and take the actions necessary to stick to those habits day in and day out for greater success
components.note: 两个并列不定式，necessary 是 actions 的后置定语

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词；stick to a plan / stick to a habit。
phrases.example: Stick to your plan and you will improve. 坚持计划就会进步。

pitfalls: it 作形式主语，真正主语是后面一长串并列不定式；necessary 后置修饰 actions。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出行动建议：养成好习惯并日复一日坚持。

sentences.quote: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们日常行为中几乎一半是习惯的一部分而不是决定，所以一旦正确的习惯就位，你就会在每天的基础上自动完成那些任务。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们每天做的事，近一半根本不经过大脑，是习惯在推着走；所以好习惯一旦养成，相关的事自然就做了。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Almost half of our daily actions】 _are_ ~part of our habits and not decisions~, {so once the correct habits are in place}, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + so 连接结果分句（内含 once 时间状语从句）

components.part: Almost half of our daily actions
components.note: half of + 复数名词，谓语用复数 are
与复数主语一致

components.part: part of our habits and not decisions
components.note: and not 连接并列否定成分

components.part: so once the correct habits are in place
components.note: so 表结果，once 引导时间状语从句

clauses: once 引导时间状语从句，意为「一旦……就」；so 连接并列的结果分句。

phrases.usage: 较正式的说法，相当于 every day / day in and day out。
phrases.example: She practises on a day-to-day basis. 她每天练习。

pitfalls: half of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用复数 are。
in place 意为「就位、生效」，不是「在某个地方」。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用「近半日常行为出于习惯」支撑自动化执行的论点，是第 47 题的直接依据。

sentences.quote: The best way to create and stick to a habit is to have strong motivation.

analysis.translationLiteral: 养成并坚持一个习惯的最好方式，是拥有强烈的动机。
analysis.translationNatural: 想让习惯立得住，最管用的是有一个足够强的理由。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The best way to create and stick to a habit】 _is_ ~to have strong motivation~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 不定式作后置定语 + 不定式作表语

components.part: The best way to create and stick to a habit
components.note: 核心词 way，不定式作后置定语
连接表语
不定式作表语，说明「最好的方式」是什么

analysis.paragraphRole: 提出第四段的核心主张：强动机是养成习惯的关键。

sentences.quote: It's easier to change your habits to lose weight if you have a health issue and you want to be around longer for your kids, or if your business is something you're passionate about.

analysis.translationLiteral: 如果你有健康问题、想为了孩子活得更久，或者你的事业正是你热爱的东西，改变习惯去减重会更容易。
analysis.translationNatural: 比如查出健康问题、想多陪孩子几年，或者做的正是自己热爱的事业，这时改掉旧习惯去减肥就容易得多。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】's ~easier~ (to change your habits to lose weight) {if you have a health issue and you want to be around longer for your kids, or if your business is something you're passionate about}.
analysis.structureSummary: it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 两个 if 并列条件状语从句

components.note: It's 中的 it 是形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式
比较级形容词作表语

components.part: to change your habits to lose weight
components.note: 不定式作真正主语，to lose weight 表目的

components.part: if you have a health issue and you want to be around longer for your kids, or if your business is something you're passionate about
components.note: 两个 if 从句用 or 并列，列举强动机的来源

clauses: 两个 if 引导并列条件状语从句，用 or 连接。
something 后是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句 you're passionate about。

phrases.usage: about 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: He is passionate about teaching. 他对教学充满热情。

pitfalls: It's 是 It is 的缩写，it 为形式主语；真正主语是不定式 to change...。
be around 在此意为「活在世上、陪伴在身边」，不是「在附近」。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用两个生活化场景说明「看得见的结果」如何提供强动机，对应第 48 题。

sentences.quote: Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.

analysis.translationLiteral: 让一个有价值的结果与某个习惯相关联，将帮助你自己永久地坚持那个习惯。
analysis.translationNatural: 只要把一个值得要的结果挂在这个习惯上，你就能一直坚持下去。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit】 _will help_ ~you~ (stick to that habit permanently).
analysis.structureSummary: 动名词短语作主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 不带 to 的不定式作宾补

components.part: Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit
components.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数；associated with... 是过去分词作后置定语
help sb (to) do 结构，此处不定式不带 to
help 的宾语
不定式作宾语补足语，说明 help 的具体内容

pitfalls: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可省；本句用的是不带 to 的 stick。
associated with a habit 是过去分词短语，修饰 outcome，不是谓语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束本段，把「预期结果」与习惯绑定，是第 48 题答案的落点。

sentences.quote: The art of self-control is one that most successful individuals have mastered.

analysis.translationLiteral: 自我控制的艺术，是大多数成功人士已经掌握了的一样东西。
analysis.translationNatural: 自我控制这门功夫，多数成功者早就练成了。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The art of self-control】 _is_ ~one that most successful individuals have mastered~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 定语从句（that 引导）

components.note: 核心词 art，of 短语作后置定语
连接表语

components.part: one that most successful individuals have mastered
components.note: 代词 one 指代「一门本领」，后接定语从句

clauses: that 引导定语从句修饰代词 one，that 在从句中作 mastered 的宾语。
pitfalls: 先行词是不定代词 one 时，定语从句通常用 that 引导，不用 which。
analysis.paragraphRole: 转向「自我控制」，把它归入成功者已经掌握的本领。

sentences.quote: Self-control enables you to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do.

analysis.translationLiteral: 自我控制使你能避开那些无助于成功的行为，并采取那些有助于成功的行为。
analysis.translationNatural: 有了自控力，你就能躲开拖后腿的做法，去做真正有用的事。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Self-control】 _enables_ ~you~ (to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 不定式作宾补（含两个并列定语从句）

components.note: 抽象名词作主语
enable sb to do，用带 to 的不定式
enable 的宾语

components.part: to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do
components.note: avoid 与 adopt 是两个并列不定式动作，后一个省略 to

clauses: that don't contribute to your success 是定语从句，修饰 behaviors。
that do 是定语从句修饰 those，do 替代 contribute to your success 以免重复。

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: Regular exercise contributes to good health. 规律运动有助于健康。

pitfalls: enable sb to do 必须带 to，与 help sb (to) do 不同。
those that do 中的 do 是替代动词，指 contribute to your success。
analysis.paragraphRole: 解释自我控制如何起作用：避开无益行为、采取有益行为，对应第 49 题。

sentences.quote: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track.

analysis.translationLiteral: 因为与自我控制相关联的是一种延迟的满足感，所以跑偏可能是容易的。
analysis.translationNatural: 自控的回报来得太慢，人就很容易半途松劲。
analysis.structMarkup: {Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control}, 【it】 _can be_ ~easy~ (to get off track).
analysis.structureSummary: Because 原因状语从句 + it 形式主语 + 主系表

components.part: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control
components.note: Because 引导原因；there be 句型，associated with... 作后置定语
形式主语，真正主语是句末不定式
情态动词 + be，表示可能性
形容词作表语
不定式是真正的主语内容

clauses: Because 引导原因状语从句，说明为什么容易偏离。

phrases.usage: track 指轨道或方向；反义表达 stay on track。
phrases.example: It's easy to get off track without a plan. 没有计划很容易跑偏。

pitfalls: delayed satisfaction（延迟满足）是全段解释自控难的原因，也是第 50 题的题眼。
analysis.paragraphRole: 指出自控的难处：回报是延迟的，直接对应第 50 题。

sentences.quote: However, if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time, it becomes easier to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward.

analysis.translationLiteral: 然而，如果你致力于一天一天地坚持那些细小的积极习惯，保持坚定并获得那份延迟的回报就会变得更容易。
analysis.translationNatural: 但只要一次一天、把那些小习惯一个个守住，撑住并等到回报就没那么难了。
analysis.structMarkup: (However), {if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time}, 【it】 _becomes_ ~easier~ (to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward).
analysis.structureSummary: if 条件状语从句 + it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 并列不定式

components.note: 转折连接副词

components.part: if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time
components.note: if 引导条件；work on 后接动名词 sticking
形式主语
表示状态变化
比较级，隐含与上句对比

components.part: to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward
components.note: 两个并列不定式作真正主语

clauses: if 引导条件状语从句；work on 后接动名词，不能接动词原形。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出对策：一天一天地坚持小习惯，延迟回报终会到手。

sentences.quote: Once a reward is achieved, it is much easier to continue sticking to your habits.

analysis.translationLiteral: 一旦一份回报被获得，继续坚持你的习惯就会容易得多。
analysis.translationNatural: 尝到第一口甜头之后，再坚持就容易多了。
analysis.structMarkup: {Once a reward is achieved}, 【it】 _is_ ~much easier~ (to continue sticking to your habits).
analysis.structureSummary: Once 时间状语从句 + it 形式主语 + 主系表

components.note: Once 引导时间状语从句，被动语态
形式主语
连接表语
much 修饰比较级加强程度

components.part: to continue sticking to your habits
components.note: 不定式作真正主语；continue 后接动名词

clauses: Once 引导时间状语从句，意为「一旦」。
pitfalls: 修饰比较级用 much / far，不用 very。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束全文：拿到第一份回报后，坚持会进入正循环。

questions.stem: What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower?

options.text: Keep it under control.
Apply it continuously.
Learn from entrepreneurs.
Aim at success determinedly.

questions.stem: How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage?

options.text: Out of habit.
With determination.
Like muscle building.
By self-discipline.

questions.stem: What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically?

options.text: Practising it on a day-to-day basis.
Associating it with improving health.
Possessing a reasonable amount of talent.
Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield.

questions.stem: How does the art of self-control help us succeed?

options.text: By allowing us to remain clear-headed permanently.
By enabling us to alter our behaviors constantly.
By enabling us to take positive actions.
By allowing us to avoid taking risks.

questions.stem: Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control?

options.text: Most of us are not in the habit of exercising self-control.
We may not get immediate rewards from self-control.
Self-control tends to be associated with pains.
Self-control only brings about small benefits.

collocations: to the best of one's ability
examples: The ability to focus is underrated. 专注的能力被低估了。
She achieved her goal in two years. 她两年内实现了目标。

lexicon.sense: achieve 的过去分词，实现、取得

examples: The school adopted a new rule. 学校采纳了一条新规。

lexicon.sense: allow 的第三人称单数，使能够、允许
数量（不可数）；总额 / 合计为
examples: They share the same amount of care. 他们承担同等数量的照护。

lexicon.sense: 艺术；技巧、本事（本文取后者）
examples: The art of listening takes practice. 倾听的技巧需要练习。

lexicon.sense: 有关联的；associate 的过去分词
examples: Smoking is associated with lung disease. 吸烟与肺病相关。
Avoid making the same mistake. 避免犯同样的错。

lexicon.sense: 基础、依据；on a ... basis 以……方式
examples: We meet on a weekly basis. 我们每周碰一次面。

lexicon.sense: become 的第三人称单数，变得

examples: His behavior surprised everyone. 他的举止让所有人意外。
I believe he is right. 我认为他是对的。

lexicon.sense: bear 的过去分词；be born with 天生具有
examples: She was born with perfect pitch. 她天生有绝对音感。

lexicon.sense: 生意、商业（不可数）；公司（可数）；事、分内事
examples: People in business rely on instincts. 商界人士依赖直觉。

lexicon.sense: 改变、变化 / 变化、零钱
examples: Attitudes are changing slowly. 态度正在缓慢改变。

lexicon.sense: connection 的复数，人脉、联系（本文指人脉）

examples: Constant practice makes perfect. 持续练习才能熟能生巧。

lexicon.sense: 继续（continue to do / continue doing）
examples: The practice continues in many firms. 这种做法在许多公司延续。
Sleep contributes to good memory. 睡眠有助于好记性。
Try to control your temper. 尽量控制住脾气。
Please correct my spelling. 请改正我的拼写。
They create powerful new communicative forms. 他们创造出有力的新沟通形式。

lexicon.sense: 至关重要的；批判的（本文取前者）
examples: Sleep is critical to health. 睡眠对健康至关重要。
The shop opens daily. 这家店每天都开。
She handles the day-to-day running of the shop. 她负责店铺的日常运营。
The train was delayed by snow. 火车因雪延误了。
She finished the race with determination. 她凭着决心跑完了比赛。
He developed a reading habit. 他养成了阅读习惯。
This word is difficult to pronounce. 这个词很难念。

lexicon.sense: 自律、纪律；训练、惩处（本文取「自律」）
examples: Writing every day takes discipline. 每天写作需要自律。

lexicon.sense: 更容易的（easy 的比较级）
examples: Deleting posts is easier than before. 删帖比以前更容易。
The task looks easy. 这任务看着简单。

lexicon.sense: enable 的第三人称单数，使能够
伦理、道德观；work ethic 职业精神
锻炼（不可数）；练习、习题（可数）/ 锻炼
examples: Regular exercise improves sleep. 规律锻炼能改善睡眠。
As kids get older they write more carefully. 孩子越大写得越小心。

lexicon.sense: 去、走；（go up/down）上升/下降；进行
collocations: there is still some way to go
examples: Satisfaction went down for many women. 许多女性满意度下降。

lexicon.sense: 好的；有益的 / 好处（不可数）
examples: A rich social life is good for health. 丰富社交生活有益健康。
They do not reflect the great mass of behaviour. 它们没有反映行为的主体。

lexicon.sense: 更大的（great 的比较级）；更重大的
examples: The web is replaced in reaction to greater independence. 因为更独立，网络被替换了。

lexicon.sense: 习惯（本文指养成的固定行为）
examples: I check my phone out of habit. 我习惯性地看手机。
Healthy habits start early. 健康习惯从小养成。
Half of the students agreed. 一半学生同意。

lexicon.sense: 手；帮助（give sb a hand）/ 递（动词）
examples: On the other hand, there is a rational approach. 另一方面，也有理性的方法。

lexicon.sense: have 的动名词/现在分词，具有、拥有

examples: Social ties affect health. 社会联系影响健康。

lexicon.sense: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）
examples: Instincts can help you decide fast. 直觉能帮你快速决定。

lexicon.sense: 然而（副词，须用分号或句号连接）；无论怎样
examples: However, the study also shows a gap. 然而，研究也显示出一道差距。
Money is not the issue here. 钱不是这里的问题。

lexicon.sense: it is 或 it has 的缩写（注意与 its 所有格区分）
examples: It's hard to say. 很难说。
Keep the room clean. 保持房间整洁。
Practice is the key to progress. 练习是进步的关键。
We learn from mistakes. 我们从错误中学习。

lexicon.sense: 像（介词）；喜欢（动词）；口语连词「像……那样」
examples: Tools like this save time. 这样的工具能省时间。

lexicon.sense: 更长的（long 的比较级）；（no longer）不再
examples: Essays are now six times longer. 现在文章长了六倍。
It was pure luck. 那纯属运气。

lexicon.sense: master 的过去分词，掌握、精通

examples: Clear goals give you motivation. 明确的目标能给你动力。
He pulled a muscle while running. 他跑步时拉伤了肌肉。
Bring a pen if necessary. 有必要的话带支笔。

lexicon.sense: 需要（情态/实义动词）；需要、需求（名词）
examples: Parents need to set boundaries. 家长需要划定界限。

lexicon.sense: 一次；曾经 / 一旦（连词）
examples: The web is headed for change once again. 网络再次走向变革。
Nobody predicted the outcome. 没人预料到这个结果。
He is passionate about music. 他对音乐充满热情。

lexicon.sense: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
examples: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。
Computers help students perform better. 电脑帮助学生学习表现更好。

lexicon.sense: 积极的、正面的；确定的；阳性的
examples: The facts are much more positive. 事实要正面得多。
They arrive at the best possible decisions. 他们做出尽可能最好的决定。
The reward came years later. 回报多年后才到来。
She smiled with satisfaction. 她满意地笑了。
Self-control helps you save money. 自制力能帮你存下钱。
A small fraction of men did more childcare. 极小一部分男性承担更多育儿。
If you feel something should not be done... 如果你觉得某事不该做……
Stay calm. 保持冷静。
Stick to the rules. 请遵守规则。

lexicon.sense: stick 的动名词/现在分词，本文用于 stick to（坚持）

examples: Exercise strengthens the heart. 运动能增强心脏功能。
She has a strong will. 她意志坚定。
Hard work is not the only route to success. 努力并非成功的唯一路径。
The policy has been broadly successful. 该政策总体上是成功的。
He has a talent for languages. 他有语言天赋。
Splitting tasks fairly matters. 公平分担任务很重要。

lexicon.sense: 时间；次数；时机 / 计时
examples: It takes time to change habits. 改变习惯需要时间。
Keep track of your spending. 记下你的开销。
That was a valuable lesson. 那是宝贵的一课。

lexicon.sense: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要
examples: They want to appear more adult. 他们想显得更成熟。

lexicon.sense: 方法、方式；路；程度（in a way）
collocations: the best way to do sth
examples: There is no simple way to fix it. 没有简单的办法解决它。
He is trying to lose weight. 他在努力减重。
It takes willpower to get up early. 早起需要意志力。

lexicon.sense: 没有、不带（后接名词或动名词）
examples: Without making things complicated, the answer is simple. 不把事情弄复杂的话，答案很简单。
I wonder why he left. 我想知道他为什么走了。

lexicon.sense: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品
examples: The approach works in practice. 这个方法在实践中奏效。
